MgmtMemberChannelsSkip.description: Why a sync item changed nothing for its person.

oneOf.description:
The person is the Space's owner (the App's service owner): the sync never removes,
demotes or replaces the owner, who is in every channel.
The person was deprovisioned; only `principals/provision` brings them back.
The Space bans the person; bans win over the sync.
The Space is at its App's `members_per_space_max`, so the person could not join.

SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).

description: Answer of one sync item. Channel lists are ascending.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

level.description: The person's level after the sync (absent when `skipped`).

queued.description:
The item has more than 1,000 channel changes and runs as a job: `added`, `removed`
and `unchanged` are empty, `job_id` names the job (`GET /mgmt/v1/jobs/{id}`). A later
sync of the same person replaces a job that has not run.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

skipped.description: Set when the item changed nothing for its person, with why.

unchanged.description: Listed channels the person was in already.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

unknown_channel_ids.description:
Listed ids that are not live private channels of this Space (unknown, in another
Space, archived, public or a meeting's channel); the rest of the list applied.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).
